idea: How to detect a leaking toilet
title: How to Detect a Silent Toilet Flapper Leak
description: An educational guide demonstrating how to use a simple dye test to identify silent flush valve leaks in a toilet tank.
image_prompt: A professional educational 3D cross-section cutaway photo of a white ceramic toilet tank and bowl in a brightly lit modern bathroom. Inside the upper porcelain tank, clear water is tinted with vibrant dark blue liquid dye. At the bottom of the tank, a flexible rubber flapper valve is slightly unseated on the plastic flush valve orifice, allowing a thin stream of deep blue water to seep down into the clear water of the lower toilet bowl. Clear physical details showing the fill valve, overflow tube, and flapper assembly inside the tank. High-detail realistic materials, clean lighting, 9:16 vertical orientation, centered composition with clean background space at the top and bottom. No text, no captions, no arrows, no watermarks, no logos, no visual overlays.
visual_story: The visual uses a clear sectional cutaway to highlight the hidden path water takes between the tank and bowl. By showing dark blue dye dispersing in the upper tank and trickling past a compromised flapper valve down into the lower bowl, the viewer visually connects an unseen interior failure with an observable result in the bowl without needing to pull the flush lever.

on_image_text.hook: Silent toilet leaks waste hundreds of liters daily.
on_image_text.explanation: A degraded rubber flapper allows tank water to continuously trickle into the bowl.
on_image_text.takeaway: Add food dye to the tank; if color enters the bowl within 15 minutes without flushing, replace the seal.
